summary: Rewrote the ticket Detail body as the Spec / Progress / Outcome tab bar: marked-rendered body with blockers line on Spec, status + interrupt form + timeline/log-pane on Progress, summary + commit sha or placeholder on Outcome; tab defaults from the ticket-02 projection with a red interrupt dot on Progress; body fetched once per ticket via /api/ticket, cached (null for known-missing) with the stale-selection guard. Added the marked dependency with bun, removed the dead never-run spec threading, and pinned the new projections with unit tests. Full suite green: root 241 pass, ui 93 pass, both typechecks and vite build clean. Also recorded a cross-pool worktree collision (arch-review's engine deleted the shared pool/03 branch mid-attempt) in the Issue notes.
